method: Applied by the reviewer AFTER scoring, only where a vendor page was re-read and contradicted the agent. Accuracy figures on the page are measured on agent output before these fixes.

corrections.why: v3 API authenticates with an API key sent as a Bearer header; Basic auth is not supported.
App review applies only to App Store listing; custom apps on a free dev store need none.
WooCommerce MCP is a developer preview.
'other' is not a schema value; HTTP Query API is REST (Bolt is a driver protocol).
